fixtureDiscipline: Every fact pattern wholly invented (Cedarview Materials, Inc. / Anchorline Capital, LLC / Fenwick Distribution, Inc. / Union Point Lender, LLC) - never Riot/Coinbase or any real known-package (FWRG/LSB/CONMED/DSGR) name, section number, or date. Uses the REAL, unmodified-except-by-this-session production functions end to end (buildPackageGraph, runAmendmentPipeline, computeOperativeDocument, computeOperativeContractState, buildNodeSupersessionIndex, getNodeSupersessionStatus, resolveOperativeSectionEvidence, buildSourceInventory) - never a mock of any of them. A final test mechanically greps this file's own fixture text for banned strings.

requiredScenarios.S1_simpleRestatement: PASS - V1's node KNOWN_SUPERSEDED (DOCUMENT_LEVEL, supersedingOperativeDocumentId=cv2) once a real 2-document RESOLVED restatement chain resolves; V2's own node stays CURRENT_OPERATIVE.
requiredScenarios.S2_threeDocChain: PASS - both V1 and V2 report KNOWN_SUPERSEDED within their own instrument's supersession index once V3 resolves operative; V3 stays current. Also exercises S11 (control) in the same fixture.
requiredScenarios.S3_ordinaryAmendment_unchangedNodeStaysC: PASS - an ordinary (non-restatement) amendment leaves operativeDocument NOT_APPLICABLE, documentLevelSupersededDocuments empty, and the base document's own untouched node CURRENT_OPERATIVE.
requiredScenarios.S4_ordinaryAmendmentSpecificProvision_ex: PASS - the SPECIFIC amended section is KNOWN_SUPERSEDED with supersessionKind PROVISION_LEVEL (not DOCUMENT_LEVEL) and supersedingOperativeDocumentId null - the pre-existing mechanism is untouched, not replaced.
requiredScenarios.S5_unresolvedRestatementTarget_neverAffi: PASS - a malformed/unresolvable restatement target yields a non-RESOLVED operativeDocument; documentLevelSupersededDocuments stays empty; the predecessor's node stays CURRENT_OPERATIVE.
requiredScenarios.S6_fork_neverManufactureCurrentness: PASS - two documents claiming to restate the same predecessor yields REVIEW_REQUIRED; no document-level record is ever created for either.
requiredScenarios.S7_cycle_safeUncertainty: PASS - a hand-built two-document restatement cycle yields REVIEW_REQUIRED with reviewReason containing "cycle"; no document-level record created.
requiredScenarios.S8_historicalProvenance_retrievableBySta: PASS - after DOCUMENT_LEVEL supersession, the node's own physical text remains fully, byte-identically retrievable via the structural index.
requiredScenarios.S9_historicalSourceTrust_neverTrustedCur: PASS - resolveOperativeSectionEvidence's no-provision-view branch reports isCurrentTruth=false / status KNOWN_SUPERSEDED for a document-level-historical node.
requiredScenarios.S10_verifier_historicalTextMatchNotVerif: PASS - buildSourceInventory reports supersessionStatus KNOWN_SUPERSEDED for a document-level-historical node despite an exact, valid citation/quote match.
requiredScenarios.S11_currentSourceControl_equivalentClaim: PASS (in S2's own fixture) - the real current operative document's own node resolves isCurrentTruth=true / CURRENT_OPERATIVE, confirming the fix does not over-trigger.
requiredScenarios.S12_tenantIsolation: PASS - two unrelated document families' states combined into one buildNodeSupersessionIndex call never cross-contaminate documentLevelSupersededDocuments membership.
requiredScenarios.S13_unrelatedDocumentFamilyIsolation: PASS - an unrelated Security Agreement co-occurring in the same index build with a real restatement chain is never swept into DOCUMENT_LEVEL supersession merely by co-occurrence.
requiredScenarios.S14_notApplicableUnchangedBehavior: PASS - a package with zero restatement activity behaves identically to pre-fix baseline (CURRENT_OPERATIVE default, empty documentLevelSupersededDocuments).
requiredScenarios.S15_multipleHistoricalPredecessorsAllCon: PASS (in S2's own fixture) - both V1 and V2 consistently report KNOWN_SUPERSEDED, never a partial/inconsistent result across predecessors.

requiredAdversarialScenarios.A_noProvisionEffectRecorded: PASS - zero provisions attached for the fixture (confirmed via state.provisions.length===0); node still correctly KNOWN_SUPERSEDED via the whole-document rule alone.
requiredAdversarialScenarios.B_identicalTextToCurrentDoc: PASS - a section byte-identical between the historical predecessor and the current operative document (never touched by the restatement's own economic changes) still reports KNOWN_SUPERSEDED for the historical copy - text equality never implies currentness.
requiredAdversarialScenarios.C_exactHighQualityCitation: PASS - buildSourceInventory with a real, exact, verbatim citation/quote still reports KNOWN_SUPERSEDED, never upgraded by citation quality.
requiredAdversarialScenarios.D_verifierSemanticAgreement: PASS - the no-provision-view (CASE D-equivalent) path fails closed to isCurrentTruth=false regardless of any downstream semantic agreement, since no OperativeProvisionView exists to independently 'agree' with in this shape.
requiredAdversarialScenarios.E_preResolutionPersistedNode: PASS - a node considered CURRENT_OPERATIVE by an earlier, narrower index (built before the chain's own restatement effects were known) is proven non-sticky: a freshly-built index from the real, current state correctly reports KNOWN_SUPERSEDED, and the earlier index is shown unmutated (still reporting its own original verdict) - proving each index build is a pure function of its own input, never cached/reused across states.
requiredAdversarialScenarios.F_chainResolvedAfterEarlierUncertainty: PASS - a chain that starts REVIEW_REQUIRED (malformed date) and is later corrected to RESOLVED (in a wholly separate, fresh pipeline run) correctly flips to KNOWN_SUPERSEDED - no earlier uncertainty leaves a stale CURRENT verdict cached anywhere; the original REVIEW_REQUIRED-era index remains provably unmutated.
